400.description: `INVALID_INPUT`: `page` or `size` out of range (`OUT_OF_RANGE`).

post.description: The person appears in the member list as `INVITED`. The answer is the same whether or not the email already has an account (S2-AC-15); it never carries a link (S2-AC-23).

400.description: `INVALID_INPUT`: `email` malformed or over 100, `name` empty or over 50 (S2-AC-19). `COMPANY_NOT_ACTIVE`: the company is `ARCHIVED` (S2-AC-18).

400.description: `OWN_ACCOUNT`: the row is the caller. `MEMBER_IS_MANAGER`: the row is another manager (S2-AC-28).

parameters.description: The `id` of the row in the member list.

400.description: `INVITATION_NOT_RESENDABLE`: the invitation cannot be sent again from here. One code whatever the reason (S2-AC-31).

403.description: `FORBIDDEN`: the caller belongs to the company but is not its manager (S2-AC-09). `CSRF_TOKEN_INVALID`.

404.description: `NOT_FOUND`: no such company, or the caller does not belong to it. No row of this company has this ID (S2-AC-32).

429.description: `RATE_LIMITED`: more than 20 invitations, sent again included, in 60 seconds (S2-AC-20). `Retry-After` says when to try again.

post.summary: Send the invitation of a member again

post.description: Stores a PNG, JPEG, GIF, or WebP file as a temporary image of the caller and answers its ID, before there is an issue or a comment to put it on (S5-AC-01). Write it into the Markdown as `![description](attachment:{id})` and send the ID in `imageIds` of the request that saves the issue or the comment; that attaches it. The format is judged by the first bytes of the file, never by its name or the `Content-Type` sent, and decides the `Content-Type` the image is served with (S5-AC-02, S5-AC-03). A temporary image not attached within 24 hours is deleted (S5-AC-30). A caller has at most 20 temporary images and 50 MB of them at once; attached and expired ones do not count (S5-AC-05). Temporary images count against the team quota (S5-AC-06).

400.description: `FILE_NOT_IMAGE`: not one of the four formats. `FILE_EMPTY`, `FILE_TOO_LARGE` (over 10 MB), `TEMPORARY_IMAGE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` (the caller's temporary images would pass 20 or 50 MB), `ATTACHMENT_QUOTA_EXCEEDED` (team quota), `INVALID_INPUT` (field `file` `REQUIRED`: no `file` part or no file name; `TOO_LONG`: name over 255) (S5-AC-04).

413.description: `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE`: the request is over the upload limit.

429.description: `RATE_LIMITED`: more than 30 uploads in 60 seconds, counted together with `uploadAttachment` (S5-AC-07).

503.description: `SERVER_BUSY`: 16 uploads are running, attachments and images together; try again after `Retry-After` (S5-AC-07).

post.summary: Upload an image for an issue's content or a comment

get.description: The contents of a temporary image, for the caller who uploaded it and nobody else, a colleague neither (S5-AC-10, S5-AC-11): the preview of a content that is not saved yet. The headers are those of `downloadAttachment`, `Content-Disposition: attachment` and `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`; a browser shows it in an `` all the same. Takes `Range` requests. Once a save attached the image, read it with `downloadAttachment` of its issue; this path answers 404 from then on (S5-AC-12).

206.description: Part of the image, for a `Range` request.

404.description: `NOT_FOUND`: one identical response for an unknown ID, an image another account uploaded, and an image that is attached already, over 24 hours old, deleted, or still being written (S5-AC-11, S5-AC-12).

503.description: `SERVER_BUSY`: 16 downloads are running, attachments and images together; try again after `Retry-After` (S5-AC-07).

head.description: The headers `downloadImage` would send, without the body.

200.description: The image exists and the caller may read it.

404.description: `NOT_FOUND`: one identical response for an unknown ID, an image another account uploaded, and an image that is attached already, over 24 hours old, deleted, or still being written (S5-AC-11, S5-AC-12).

get.description: Public issues of the caller's companies and every issue the caller reported, newest first (S0-AC-47). The filters narrow that and never widen it: with several, an issue must match all of them (S3-AC-08, S3-AC-10).

parameters.description: Only issues with one of these statuses. Give it once for each status.
parameters.name: status

parameters.description: Only issues of the company with this code. A company the caller does not belong to gives an empty page.
parameters.name: companyCode

parameters.description: Only issues whose title or content, as shown, holds this text, 1 to 100 characters. Case is ignored; `%` and `_` are ordinary characters (COM-5).
parameters.name: q

400.description: `INVALID_INPUT`: `page` or `size` out of range (`OUT_OF_RANGE`), unknown `status` (`UNKNOWN_VALUE`), `q` empty or over 100 characters (`TOO_SHORT`, `TOO_LONG`, S3-AC-14) or with a character that cannot be stored (`INVALID_FORMAT`), or a parameter customers may not use, such as `assignee`, `reporter`, `label`, `sla`, `sort` (`UNKNOWN_PARAMETER`, S0-AC-48, S3-AC-09).

429.description: `RATE_LIMITED`: more than 60 lists with `q` in 60 seconds (S3-AC-15). This is the only list of the portal that counts toward the limit (COM-8).

post.description: Files an issue in a company the caller belongs to (S0-AC-41): key `{code}-{number}`, status `RECEIVED`, channel `PORTAL`. Send JSON, or `multipart/form-data` with the issue as JSON in part `issue` and files in parts `files` to attach them in the same request (S0-AC-56).

parameters.description: Makes a retry safe: a filing with a key this account used in the last 24 hours answers with the issue that key made (S3-AC-41). 1 to 100 visible ASCII characters. See "Filing an issue once" in the conventions.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

201.description: Created. Also for a retry with the same `Idempotency-Key` and content: the issue made the first time, as it is now (S3-AC-41).

400.description: `INVALID_INPUT`: `title` empty or over 200, `content` over 10,000, `priority` unknown; `fields` lists all (S0-AC-42). `COMPANY_NOT_ACTIVE`: the company is not `ACTIVE`. `INVALID_INPUT` with field `Idempotency-Key` (`INVALID_FORMAT`, `TOO_LONG`): the key is not 1 to 100 visible ASCII characters (S3-AC-45). With files: `FILE_EMPTY`, `FILE_TOO_LARGE` (over 10 MB), `ISSUE_ATTACHMENTS_TOO_LARGE` (public attachments of the issue over 50 MB), `ATTACHMENT_QUOTA_EXCEEDED` (team quota), and `INVALID_INPUT` with field `files` `TOO_LONG` (file name over 255) (S0-AC-57, S0-AC-58). Nothing is created then (S0-AC-63). With `imageIds`: `TEMPORARY_IMAGE_INVALID` (an ID is not a temporary image the caller uploaded, or the image is attached already or over 24 hours old; one answer whatever the reason and whichever ID, S5-AC-21), `ISSUE_ATTACHMENTS_TOO_LARGE` (with the images, the public attachments of the issue would pass 50 MB, S5-AC-23), and `INVALID_INPUT` with field `imageIds` `TOO_MANY` (over 20) or `INVALID_FORMAT` (not a list of strings). Nothing is saved then. The 50 MB counts the files and the images of the filing together.

404.description: `NOT_FOUND`: the caller does not belong to the company (S0-AC-43).

409.description: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`: the account used this `Idempotency-Key` for a filing with other content (S3-AC-42).

413.description: `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE`: the request is over the upload limit, or has more than 20 files (S1A-AC-65).

429.description: `RATE_LIMITED`: more than 10 issues in 60 seconds (S0-AC-50). The files of a filing also count toward the limit on attachment uploads, 30 in 60 seconds (S1A-AC-66).

503.description: `SERVER_BUSY`: 16 uploads are running; try again after `Retry-After` (S0-AC-99).

404.description: `NOT_FOUND`: no such issue, or the caller cannot see it (COM-1).

patch.description: For the reporter. A field left out keeps its value; the rules for each field are those of filing (S3-AC-18). Saving goes up `version` by 1; sending what the issue already has changes nothing and is 200 too (S3-AC-22).

200.description: The issue as it is now.

400.description: `INVALID_INPUT`: `version` missing (`REQUIRED`), `title` empty, over 200, or `null`, `content` over 10,000, `priority` unknown or `null`; `fields` lists all. `ISSUE_CLOSED`: the issue is `CLOSED` (S3-AC-21). With `imageIds`: `TEMPORARY_IMAGE_INVALID` (an ID is not a temporary image the caller uploaded, or the image is attached already or over 24 hours old; one answer whatever the reason and whichever ID, S5-AC-21), `ISSUE_ATTACHMENTS_TOO_LARGE` (with the images, the public attachments of the issue would pass 50 MB, S5-AC-23), and `INVALID_INPUT` with field `imageIds` `TOO_MANY` (over 20) or `INVALID_FORMAT` (not a list of strings). Nothing is saved then.

403.description: `FORBIDDEN`: the caller is not the reporter, or no longer belongs to the company (S3-AC-20). `CSRF_TOKEN_INVALID`.

404.description: `NOT_FOUND`: no such issue, or the caller cannot see it (COM-1).

409.description: `VERSION_CONFLICT`: `version` is not the issue's current one; nothing changed. Read the issue again (S3-AC-19).

patch.summary: Change an issue's title, content, or priority

get.description: Files on the issue and on its public comments, oldest first. Attachments of internal comments are left out (S0-AC-60). Deleted attachments stay as traces (`deleted`).

400.description: `INVALID_INPUT`: `page` or `size` out of range (`OUT_OF_RANGE`).

404.description: `NOT_FOUND`: no such issue, or the caller cannot see it.

post.description: Attaches a file to the issue, or to the caller's own comment with `commentId` (S0-AC-56). Only the reporter may attach.

400.description: `FILE_EMPTY`, `FILE_TOO_LARGE` (over 10 MB), `ISSUE_ATTACHMENTS_TOO_LARGE` (public attachments of the issue over 50 MB), `ATTACHMENT_QUOTA_EXCEEDED` (team quota), `INVALID_INPUT` (field `file` `TOO_LONG`: name over 255; field `commentId` `UNKNOWN_VALUE`: not the caller's comment on this issue, or a deleted comment) (S0-AC-57, S0-AC-58). `ISSUE_CLOSED`.

403.description: `FORBIDDEN`: the caller did not upload it. `CSRF_TOKEN_INVALID`.

404.description: `NOT_FOUND`: one identical response for an unknown ID, an issue the caller cannot see, an attachment of another issue, and a pending or deleted attachment (S0-AC-102).

get.description: Always `Content-Disposition: attachment` and `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff` (S0-AC-59). Takes `Range` requests.

206.description: Part of the file, for a `Range` request.

404.description: `NOT_FOUND`: one identical response for an unknown ID, an issue the caller cannot see, an attachment of another issue, and a pending or deleted attachment (S0-AC-102).

503.description: `SERVER_BUSY`: 16 downloads are running; try again after `Retry-After` (S0-AC-99).

head.description: The headers `downloadAttachment` would send, without the body.

200.description: The file exists and the caller may download it.

404.description: `NOT_FOUND`: one identical response for an unknown ID, an issue the caller cannot see, an attachment of another issue, and a pending or deleted attachment (S0-AC-102).

post.description: For the reporter, from any status but `CLOSED`, also after leaving the company (S3-AC-53, S3-AC-54). On a `RESOLVED` issue this confirms the resolution. Takes no body.

400.description: `ISSUE_CLOSED`: the issue is `CLOSED` already.

403.description: `FORBIDDEN`: the caller is not the reporter (S3-AC-55). `CSRF_TOKEN_INVALID`.

404.description: `NOT_FOUND`: no such issue, or the caller cannot see it (COM-1).

get.description: Oldest first (S0-AC-54). Internal comments are left out (S0-AC-53). Comments by staff have author `SUPPORT_TEAM` without name or ID (ADR D-49). A deleted comment stays in its place as a trace and is counted (`deleted`, S4-AC-10).

400.description: `INVALID_INPUT`: `page` or `size` out of range (`OUT_OF_RANGE`).

404.description: `NOT_FOUND`: no such issue, or the caller cannot see it.

post.description: Only the reporter may comment (S0-AC-51, S0-AC-52).

400.description: `INVALID_INPUT`: `content` empty or over 4,000, or not text (`INVALID_FORMAT`). `ISSUE_CLOSED`: the issue is closed. With `imageIds`: `TEMPORARY_IMAGE_INVALID` (an ID is not a temporary image the caller uploaded, or the image is attached already or over 24 hours old; one answer whatever the reason and whichever ID, S5-AC-21), `ISSUE_ATTACHMENTS_TOO_LARGE` (with the images, the public attachments of the issue would pass 50 MB, S5-AC-23), and `INVALID_INPUT` with field `imageIds` `TOO_MANY` (over 20) or `INVALID_FORMAT` (not a list of strings). Nothing is saved then.

delete.description: Only the author deletes, on a `CLOSED` issue too (S4-AC-13). The list keeps a trace: `content` is emptied and `deleted` and `deletedAt` are set (S4-AC-10, COM-7). The comment's attachments are deleted with it (S4-AC-14). Deleting a deleted comment again is 204 too and changes nothing (S4-AC-12).

patch.description: Only the author edits (S4-AC-02). A body without `content` changes nothing and is 200 too. A new `content` sets `editedAt`; the content the comment already has does not (S4-AC-06).

200.description: The comment as it is now.

400.description: `INVALID_INPUT`: `content` empty, over 4,000, or `null`, or not text (`INVALID_FORMAT`). `COMMENT_DELETED`: the comment is deleted (S4-AC-08). `ISSUE_CLOSED`: the issue is `CLOSED` (S4-AC-04). With `imageIds`: `TEMPORARY_IMAGE_INVALID` (an ID is not a temporary image the caller uploaded, or the image is attached already or over 24 hours old; one answer whatever the reason and whichever ID, S5-AC-21), `ISSUE_ATTACHMENTS_TOO_LARGE` (with the images, the public attachments of the issue would pass 50 MB, S5-AC-23), and `INVALID_INPUT` with field `imageIds` `TOO_MANY` (over 20) or `INVALID_FORMAT` (not a list of strings). Nothing is saved then.

403.description: `FORBIDDEN`: the caller did not write the comment, or left the company (S4-AC-05). `CSRF_TOKEN_INVALID`.

404.description: `NOT_FOUND`: no such issue or comment, the caller cannot see the issue, the comment belongs to another issue, or it is an internal comment (S4-AC-03).

429.description: `RATE_LIMITED`: more than 30 comments added or edited in 60 seconds (S0-AC-55, S4-AC-09).

post.description: For the reporter: a `RESOLVED` issue, or a `CLOSED` one within 14 days of `closedAt`, goes back to `RECEIVED`, and `resolvedAt` and `closedAt` are cleared (S3-AC-56). Takes no body.

400.description: `NOT_REOPENABLE`: the issue is neither `RESOLVED` nor `CLOSED`, or it was closed 14 days ago or longer (S3-AC-57).

403.description: `FORBIDDEN`: the caller is not the reporter, or no longer belongs to the company (S3-AC-55, S3-AC-58). `CSRF_TOKEN_INVALID`.

404.description: `NOT_FOUND`: no such issue, or the caller cannot see it (COM-1).

get.description: Also tells whether the session is still valid.

patch.description: A field left out keeps its value. Later email to the account uses the new language (S1A-AC-16).

400.description: `INVALID_INPUT`: `name` empty or over 50, or `null` (`REQUIRED`); `locale` not `ko` or `en` (`UNKNOWN_VALUE`), or `null` (`REQUIRED`).

patch.summary: Change the caller's name or language

put.description: Ends every other session of the account and gives this one a new session ID (S1A-AC-02, S1A-AC-17).

204.description: The password is changed. The session cookie is set again.

400.description: `CURRENT_PASSWORD_WRONG` (S1A-AC-18). `INVALID_INPUT`: the new password breaks AUTH-5 (field `newPassword`: `TOO_SHORT`, `TOO_LONG`, `BLANK`, `SAME_AS_EMAIL`).

429.description: `RATE_LIMITED`: the current password was wrong five times in a row, so this request is refused for 15 minutes. `Retry-After` says when to try again (S1A-AC-18).

delete.description: Succeeds also when there is no photo (S1A-AC-24).

204.description: The account has no photo now.

post.description: Takes a PNG, JPEG, or WebP file of up to 2 MB, judged by its content. The server keeps only a copy scaled to fit 256 px and encoded again, without the original or its metadata (S1A-AC-20, S1A-AC-21). A new photo replaces the old one.

400.description: `UNSUPPORTED_IMAGE`: not one of the three formats, or it cannot be decoded (S1A-AC-22). `IMAGE_TOO_LARGE`: width times height is over 25 million pixels for PNG and JPEG, 12 million for WebP (S1A-AC-23). `INVALID_INPUT`: no `file` part (`REQUIRED`).

503.description: `SERVER_BUSY`: 2 photos are being decoded; try again after `Retry-After` (S1A-AC-88).

get.description: Own items only, newest first (S4-AC-39, INBOX-3). An item about an issue the caller cannot see now is left out, and is back when the caller can see the issue again (S4-AC-42). What staff did has actor `SUPPORT_TEAM` without name or ID (ADR D-49, S4-AC-41).

400.description: `INVALID_INPUT`: `page` or `size` out of range (`OUT_OF_RANGE`).

post.description: Every unread item of the caller, those of issues the caller cannot see now included; nobody else's (S4-AC-45). 204 too when nothing was unread.

get.description: Counts what `listNotifications` would list and the caller has not read (S4-AC-43).
get.summary: Unread items in the caller's inbox

post.description: Marking a read item again is 204 too and keeps the first time (S4-AC-44).

404.description: `NOT_FOUND`: no such item in the caller's inbox.

get.description: The caller's own photo, or that of a customer of a company the caller belongs to (S1A-AC-25). Never a staff photo (S1A-AC-26). Always PNG, with `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, `Cache-Control: private, no-cache`, and an `ETag` (S1A-AC-87): the browser asks again every time, so the caller's right to see the photo is checked again, and gets 304 while the photo is the same.

parameters.description: The `ETag` of the copy the caller has.
parameters.name: If-None-Match

304.description: The photo still has the `ETag` sent in `If-None-Match`. No body.

404.description: `NOT_FOUND`: no such account, a customer of another company, an agent or admin, or an account without a photo. One body for all.

get.description: Sets the readable CSRF cookie before the first request that changes data (sign-in, accepting an invitation). Clients send its value back in a request header.

post.description: Sets the password, makes the account `ACTIVE`, and signs it in to its app (S0-AC-36). The response has `Cache-Control: no-store` (S0-AC-101).

204.description: Accepted and signed in. The session cookie is set.

400.description: `INVITATION_INVALID`: the token is unknown, expired, used, or replaced by a newer one, or the token is sent to the other app's host (a customer's token on the console host, a staff token on the portal host); one body for all (S0-AC-37). `INVALID_INPUT`: the password breaks AUTH-5 (field `password`: `TOO_SHORT`, `TOO_LONG`, `BLANK`, `SAME_AS_EMAIL`).

post.description: Sets the password, lifts a sign-in lock, and ends every session of the account. It does not sign in (S1A-AC-09, S1A-AC-04). The response has `Cache-Control: no-store` (S1A-AC-14).

400.description: `PASSWORD_RESET_INVALID`: the token is unknown, over 1 hour old, used, or replaced by a newer one, the account is no longer `ACTIVE`, or the token is sent to the other app's host; one body for all (S1A-AC-10, S1A-AC-84). `INVALID_INPUT`: the password breaks AUTH-5 (field `password`: `TOO_SHORT`, `TOO_LONG`, `BLANK`, `SAME_AS_EMAIL`); the token stays usable (S1A-AC-11).

post.summary: Set a new password with a reset link

post.description: Queues an email with a reset link for an `ACTIVE` account of the app of the host the request came to (S1A-AC-06). The link works for 1 hour and replaces an earlier one; a second request within 15 minutes sends nothing (S1A-AC-12). The answer is the same whether or not an email is sent (S1A-AC-05).

202.description: Taken. The same empty answer whether the email is unknown, the account is invited or suspended, or it belongs to the other app.

400.description: `INVALID_INPUT`: `email` is empty (`REQUIRED`).

429.description: `RATE_LIMITED`: more than 20 requests from one IP address in 60 seconds. `Retry-After` says when to try again (S1A-AC-13).

post.summary: Ask for a password reset email

post.description: Signs in to the app of the host the request came to: customers on the portal host, agents and admins on the console host. Creates a new session (S0-AC-17, S0-AC-21).

204.description: Signed in. The session cookie is set.

400.description: `INVALID_INPUT`: email or password is empty.

401.description: `SIGN_IN_FAILED`: the same body whether the email is unknown, the password is wrong, the account is invited, suspended, or locked, or it belongs to the other app (S0-AC-22, S0-AC-23).

429.description: `RATE_LIMITED`: more than 20 attempts from one IP address in 60 seconds. `Retry-After` says when to try again (S0-AC-24).

post.description: Deletes the caller's session (S0-AC-27). Succeeds also without a session.
